# REQ: LANG-1901 LANG-1902 LANG-1903 LANG-1904
namespace Demo
/* Block comment */
class Greeter:
    public Name as string = "world"
    def Greet(times as int) as string:
        text = "Hello, ${Name}!"
        for i in range(times):
            print text
        return text
g = Greeter()
print g.Greet(2) if g.Name != null and true
